name: ai-use-policy-generator
description: AI Use Policy Generator — Claude Desktop plugin that drafts an internal AI-use policy, client-facing disclosure clause, and safe AI checklist for solo law firms

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum && npm run deploy:artifact
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version ai-use-policy-generator-v$npm_package_version.zip ai-use-policy-generator-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
